How it works on standrewscatholicschool.com

  1. 1
    You send photos
    Regular phone or camera photos are enough — landscape, daylight, empty rooms. No special camera needed for this version.
  2. 2
    We build the tour page
    Each photo gets a title and a short caption you approve. Arrows walk visitors room-to-room in the order you choose, plus a menu to jump around.
  3. 3
    It goes on your website
    One link — “Take a Virtual Tour” — on the homepage and Admissions page. Works on phones, tablets, and computers. No app to install.

✓ This tour — regular photos

Fast to make, easy to update. Swap one photo anytime a room is repainted or rearranged.

True 360° — needs panorama photos

Lets visitors drag to look around inside a room. Possible later, but it needs 360 / panorama shots taken on purpose for each room.

What to send us — the shot list

One good wide photo per stop is enough to start. Shoot in landscape, in daylight, with the room empty if you can — that's safest for student privacy.

  • Front entrance — from the walkway, doors centered
  • Main office / welcome hall — the first thing a new family sees
  • A classroom — one lower-school and, if you like, one middle-school room
  • Library / media center — reading corner included if you have one
  • Chapel — from the back, down the center aisle
  • Gymnasium — from a corner so the whole court shows
  • Playground & courtyard — wide shot on a sunny morning

Also helpful: the name and one-line caption you want under each photo, and a simple floor sketch if you want the route map to match the real building.

Like how it feels? The real one is just your photos away.

Send the photos from the shot list and this same tour — same arrows, same menu, same gold detail dots — goes live with St. Andrew's real rooms, your captions, and your colors.
